answer_1.quote: Table -to-text generation or insight generation ) is a challenging task in natural language generation (NLG), where a NLG system generates insights from a data table.

answer_2.quote: We use the standard reference-free automatic metrics for the LogicNLG benchmark -trained table entailment metrics TAPAS and TAPEX.

answer_3.quote: In addition, we ran an LLM-as-a-judge evaluation with the Llama 3.3 70B model.

answer_4.quote: We run a crowdsourced human evaluation on a sample of our data (50 tables from each benchmark) with outputs from four LLMs: Llama, DeepSeek, Gemma and Qwen. We recruit annotators on the Prolific platform.
answer_4.guideline: We ask the annotators to spot and highlight accuracy errors in the insights on the word level, following Kasner and Dusek (2024)'s setup. We operate with four error categories: incorrect, not checkable, misleading, and other.
